title: Persistent inflation from uninitialized rates
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The `PositionManager.setInterestRateStrategy()` function enables the protocol owner to update the interest rate strategy contract. However, this operation does not include any mechanism to migrate or initialize the internal state required by the new strategy. Parameters such as `targetUtilization`, `endRateAt`, and `lastUpdate` for each vault remain uninitialized in the new strategy, which leads to inaccurate and inflated interest rate calculations.  ```solidity function setInterestRateStrategy(address _newInterestRateStrategy
